videos.title: Hands-on with Apple's first touchscreen MacBook Pro
videos.description:
We got some hands-on time with Apple’s first touchscreen MacBook Pro, featuring a PROLED XDR display. It has a Dynamic Island on the screen, and the 14-inch model weighs just 3 pounds, making it noticeably lighter than the current non-touch MacBook Pros. It also brings back the glowing Apple logo. The touchscreen OLED model starts at $2,899, and a fully specced version can cost you over $14,000. Read the full hands-on from The Verge’s Antonio G. Di Benedetto at the link in bio.
